mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.semester_id, tc.teacher_id, tc.course_id, tc.class_id, c.name AS course_name, u.name AS teacher_name, sc.name AS class_name FROM teacher_course tc JOIN course c ON c.id = tc.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = tc.teacher_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN school_class sc ON sc.id = tc.class_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE tc.deleted = 0 AND tc.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND tc.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY tc.id DESC
